articles.title: U.S. Bancorp Leadership Shift Centers On Kedia As Chairman And CEO
articles.mainIdea: U.S. Bancorp Leadership Shift Centers On Kedia As Chairman And CEO
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: U.S. Bancorp Leadership Shift Centers On Kedia As Chairman And CEO. U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) announced that CEO Gunjan Kedia has been appointed Chairman, succeeding Andrew Cecere. Longtime chairman Andrew Cecere is retiring from the board as part of the leadership transition. Chief Operations Officer Souheil Badran is retiring, prompting further changes in the senior leadership team.
